scope: Relevant axes independently assessed; remaining axes unaffected, not accepted by omission.

axes.name: Domain breadth
axes.assessment: Same universal canonical types; algorithm/theory are example materials, no domain-specific hardcoding. Structured expansion later requires versioned schemas.

axes.name: Bank object/media breadth
axes.assessment: Bounded UTF8 text/plain plus unchanged binary and URL/note; OCR/multimodal later.

axes.name: Retrieval breadth
axes.assessment: No delivery/change in this bounded card; original future requirement retained.

axes.name: Search sophistication
axes.assessment: Exact lexical existing search; coverage and rebuild visible. Semantic/hybrid later.

axes.name: Similarity semantics
axes.assessment: No delivery/change in this bounded card; original future requirement retained.

axes.name: Source sophistication
axes.assessment: No delivery/change in this bounded card; original future requirement retained.

axes.name: Capability/executor sophistication
axes.assessment: Existing local command/UI integration; no extra executor/provider.

axes.name: Research rigor
axes.assessment: No delivery/change in this bounded card; original future requirement retained.

axes.name: Temporal depth
axes.assessment: Pinned revisions/history and replay retained; time/research evolution laterR5.

axes.name: Automation/autonomy
axes.assessment: Only local passive refresh, no research scheduler/Watch.

axes.name: Analytics sophistication
axes.assessment: No delivery/change in this bounded card; original future requirement retained.

axes.name: Identity resolution sophistication
axes.assessment: No delivery/change in this bounded card; original future requirement retained.

axes.name: Personalization
axes.assessment: No delivery/change in this bounded card; original future requirement retained.

axes.name: Scale
axes.assessment: Versioned finite first profile, larger data later; no permanent global cap.

axes.name: Deployment/storage topology
axes.assessment: Local NTFS SQLite when PC on; no cloud architecture change.

axes.name: Privacy/security
axes.assessment: Private configured roots/output/diagnostic codes; public sources do not imply own ideas public.

axes.name: Collaboration
axes.assessment: No delivery/change in this bounded card; original future requirement retained.

axes.name: UI richness
axes.assessment: Mandatory first-use UX addressed by gates; richer editors/UI later, current design not UI acceptance.

axes.name: Interoperability
axes.assessment: Additive private diagnostic/config profiles, frozen v1 compatibility; canonical contracts untouched.

axes.name: Evaluation/QA
axes.assessment: Independent counterexamples local/native; blockers distinguished fromPASS; user visual gate pending.

axes.name: Cost/latency optimization
axes.assessment: Snapshot heavy work + compact coalesced observer/caches; no timing guarantees from poll interval.

axes.name: Data ownership/lifecycle
axes.assessment: Exact originals/reopen/manualverified snapshot/export; automatic pruning/retention/restore laterR3.
